ruleDefinitions.name: SysKey Registry Keys Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects handle requests and access operations to specific registry keys to calculate the SysKey Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectType, ObjectName

sequences.query: ((event_id = 4656 OR event_id = 4663) AND ObjectType = "key" AND (ObjectName = RGX("lsa\\\\JD$") OR ObjectName = RGX("lsa\\\\GBG$") OR ObjectName = RGX("lsa\\\\Skew1$") OR ObjectName = RGX("lsa\\\\Data$")))
